During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a '''secret [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy]] research station''' was located on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone trooper]] [[Denal/Legends|Denal]] led his squad into the base, where he discovered secret plans of the new Separatist [[Radar-cloaking superweapon|superweapon]].
